en.uagps_a1_desc: Universal grain wagon Uagps, built in 1971 by Fauvet Girel. Version with flat sidewalls, limited to 100 km/h.
en.uagps_b1_desc: Universal grain wagon Uagps, built in 1974 by Fauvet Girel. Version with curved sidewalls.
en.schluss_tooltip: Choose between train end boards or train end lights (SNCF, SNCB..)
en.ctc_tooltip: Enable additional Transcereales liveries from various operators
en.height_tooltip: Where should be the origin of the height?

de.uagps_b1_desc: Universalgetreidewagen Uagps, gebaut 1974 von Fauvet Girel. Version mit gewölbten Seitenwänden.
de.schluss_tooltip: Entweder Zugschlusstafeln oder Zugschlussleuchten (SNCF, SNCB..) wählen
